Local settings and repo paths configure the runtime.
The renderer reaches the OS through the privileged main process (file, git, credentials) — the second stage of the RCE chain.

info.description: Self-analysis of the TARAflow desktop application v0.16.0-beta (main @ b3a8251): renderer, preload bridge, Electron main process, git audit trail, OS keychain, draw.io iframe, Tailwind CDN, Jira integration, update check and file system. Method: TARAflow standard (harm-floor impact, weighted-mean likelihood). Tagged CRA as yardstick — whether the CRA legally applies to free, non-commercial open-source software is a separate question. Initial risk is rated without any controls; existing controls and the hardening plan (doc/Open/Security/electron-security-boundary-hardening.md) appear as mitigations.
